rows.en: VF-1S Valkyrie Roy Focker Special\nA high-performance unit for commander-class pilots. After\nFocker fell, his junior Hikaru flew it to defend the Macross.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'issued to' -> 'for'; 'Hikaru Ichijyo' -> 'Hikaru'

rows.en: SDF-1 Macross Daedalus Type\nAn alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. Through it,\nhumanity met OverTechnology far beyond any existing tech.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VT-1 Super Ostrich\nA two-seat trainer. Hikaru took it without permission for a\nSaturn date with Minmay, but the Zentradi captured them.
rows.notes: Who was captured is not stated; rendered 'the two' (Hikaru and Minmay), as in the movie. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-1A Valkyrie (Hikaru)\nHikaru's VF-1A from the movie. Flying it, he defied Misa's\norders to rescue Minmay, and so the love triangle began.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-1S Valkyrie (Hikaru)\nA high-performance unit for commanders. In the final battle, it\ncharged the foe's ship with the Macross and beat Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'commander-class pilots' -> 'commanders'; 'enemy mothership' -> 'foe's ship'

rows.en: VF-1S Valkyrie (Max)\nA high-performance unit for commander-class pilots. Max flew\nit as Skull Squadron leader and won his duel with Milia.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-4 Lightning III\nDeveloped as the VF-1's successor. When the Megaroad-01 set\nout, Hikaru flew it as the ship's air group commander.
rows.notes: Megaroad-01 not in glossary. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: SDF-1 Macross Armored Type\nAn alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. In the movie,\nunlike the TV series, it has ARMD-01 and ARMD-02 as its arms.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured TV/movie contrast

rows.en: Regult\nThe Zentradi forces' most widely used battle pod. Swapping\nweapons suits it to any operation. The troops think it's so-so.
rows.notes: Source says the troops rate it 'so-so'; rendered colloquially. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Glaug\nA high-performance unit with big cannons on both arms, plus\nmany lasers and guns. Quamzin's unit, it plagued the Macross.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'machine guns' -> 'guns'

rows.en: Nousjadeul-Ger (TV)\nA humanoid powered combat suit, nimbler and comfier than\na Regult, with shoulder cannons and many handheld weapons.
rows.notes: review: Same version qualifier is "(TV)" in the shop name of this unit (u3306) and in the VF-1 Super Pack rows (u3305, u3349); align the display name. | review: refit: 'more comfortable to ride' -> 'comfier'; 'heavily armed' folded into 'many handheld weapons'

rows.en: Nousjadeul-Ger (Movie)\nA humanoid powered combat suit, nimbler and comfier than\nthe Regult. Its design differs between TV and movie.
rows.notes: review: Same version qualifier is "(Movie)" in the shop name of this unit (u3311) and in the Super Pack rows (u3310, u3350); align the display name. | review: refit: 'more comfortable to ride' -> 'comfier'

rows.en: Queadluun-Rau (Standard)\nA high-performance Meltrandi battle suit. Highly mobile, it\nmenaced Valkyrie squadrons with big guns and many missiles.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Queadluun-Rau (Milia)\nMilia's red personal unit, unbeaten and feared even by allies.\nAfter a fierce dogfight, Max got on its tail and shot it down.
rows.notes: Subject of 'undefeated, feared even by allies' taken as Milia, not the unit. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Queadluun-Rau (Max)\nThe blue unit Max flew after marrying Milia and growing to\nZentradi size. Paired with Milia's unit, it scored big wins.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Zentradi Soldier\nA Zentradi rank-and-file soldier. Despite wearing only a space\nsuit, at over 10 m tall they can match a Battroid hand to hand.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: HWR-00-Mk II Monster (Ridden by Quamzin)\nA Monster with a delighted Boss Quamzin astride it. Apparently\nhe wanted to imitate a Western he'd once seen.
rows.notes: Coined display suffix '(Ridden by Quamzin)' for the source's 'Quamzin aboard' suffix. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Vrlitwhai Kridanik\nA Zentradi fleet commander. Tougher than common troops, he\ncan briefly work unprotected in space. A strong fighter too.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Golg Boddole Zer\nZentradi Commander-in-Chief. Core bio-unit of a mobile\nfortress built 120,000 cycles ago; bigger than other Zentradi.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'Commander-in-Chief of the Zentradi fleet' -> 'Zentradi Commander-in-Chief'; 'than an ordinary Zentradi' -> 'than other Zentradi'

rows.en: VF-11B Thunderbolt\nDeveloped to succeed the VF-1 as main fighter. Isamu flew it\nwhile hunting Zentradi remnants scattered across space.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: YF-19 Excalibur (Isamu)\nNew engines gave it high mobility but made it hard to handle --\na wild bronco that Isamu called his "little cutie."
rows.notes: Isamu's pet name for the plane rendered 'little cutie'; 'wild bronco' for the unruly-horse idiom. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: YF-21 Sturmvogel (Guld)\nA unit piloted by brain waves. To stop Sharon's new unmanned\nfighter Ghost, Guld made a suicide charge that downed both.
rows.notes: Source has 'Sturmvogel' without 'II'; mecha.json lists only 'YF-21'. Kept the nickname as written. YF-21 Sturmvogel nickname not in glossary. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: X-9 Ghost\nAn unmanned fighter hijacked by Sharon Apple. Its very high\nmobility toyed with Guld, but his suicide charge downed both.
rows.notes: Source orders the name 'Ghost X-9'; used the mecha.json form 'X-9 Ghost'. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-11C Thunderbolt\nThe U.N. Forces' main unit from 2040 on. Its forgiving handling\nand easy upkeep kept it the mainstay for a long time.
rows.notes: Source says 'U.N. Forces' (not 'New') for 2040; kept literal per the brief mapping. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-17D Nightmare (Standard)\nA stealth unit for special missions, large and heavily armed.\nAfter the Protodeviln appeared, it mainly defended City 7.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'large airframe with a big weapons load' -> 'large and heavily armed'

rows.en: VF-17S Nightmare (Kinryu/Gamlin)\nA VF-17 upgraded for commanders. After leader Kinryu died,\nGamlin became leader of Diamond Force and flew this unit.
rows.notes: Source nickname is 'Nightmare' for the VF-17S; mecha.json lists the VF-17S as 'Stealth Valkyrie'. Followed the source. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-17S Nightmare (Milia)\nTo protect City 7, cut off from the fleet by an enemy ploy,\nMayor Milia flew this VF-17S, repainted red.
rows.notes: Source does not say who repainted it; used passive. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-19F Excalibur (Standard)\nDeployed to Emerald Force. The YF-19's peaky handling was\ntoned down so that rank-and-file pilots could fly it.
rows.notes: Source nickname is 'Excalibur'; mecha.json lists the VF-19F as 'Blazer Valkyrie'. Followed the source (matches generic 'VF-19 Excalibur'). | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-19S Excalibur (Docker)\nDocker's unit as leader of Emerald Force. Unlike the standard\nunit, it adds four anti-air beam guns for more firepower.
rows.notes: Same as u3235 for the VF-19S. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Max)\nMax sortied in it to attack the Protodeviln nest. A high-end\nunit packed with new tech, such as solo fold capability.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Milia)\nMilia's red unit. She fought beside Max in Operation Stargazer,\nand once even sang in it with a Sound Booster fitted.
rows.notes: Subject of 'once sang with a Sound Booster' taken as Milia. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-19 Kai Fire Valkyrie (Basara)\nA modified VF-19. Its bright red frame has a big speaker and\nspeaker pods, and it roamed the galaxy blaring Basara's songs.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-11MAXL Kai Mylene Valkyrie (Mylene)\nA VF-11 modified for Mylene, its Battroid mode distinctly\nfeminine. She sang with Basara, the battlefield her stage.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-17T Kai Storm Valkyrie (Ray & Veffidas)\nA modified VF-17T. Ray and Veffidas flew it together as\nFIRE BOMBER members, firing up live shows even in battle.
rows.notes: Kept 'FIRE BOMBER' in capitals because the source writes it in Latin letters. | review: refit: 'as band members' -> 'as FIRE BOMBER members'

rows.en: Battle 7\nMacross 7 fleet flagship, captained by Maximilian Jenius. Its\ntrump card, the Macross Cannon, got it through many crises.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Fz-109A Elgersoln (Standard)\nA variable fighter for rank-and-file Varauta Army pilots. Said\nto derive from the U.N.'s VF-14, but nobody knows for sure.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'U.N. Forces' -> 'U.N.'

rows.en: Fz-109F Elgersoln (Gigile)\nThe Fz-109's commander model. Mainly Gigile's, it attacked\nBasara & co. repeatedly; Gamlin's team downed it over City 7.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Az-130A Panzersoln\nA variable attacker the Varauta Army made by upgrading the\nElgersoln. Its extra power made life harder still for Macross 7.
rows.notes: Source has 'Az-130A'; mecha.json lists 'Az-130 Panzersoln'. Kept the A. | review: refit: 'Macross 7 fleet' -> 'Macross 7'

rows.en: FBz-99G Zaubergeran (Gavil)\nGavil's own unit, a mighty variable bomber with all sorts of\nweapons. Supposedly. Yet Gamlin often downed it in one hit.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Queadluun-Rau (Chlore)\nPersonal unit of Chlore, who leads a rogue Meltrandi fleet.\nPilot skill plus performance let it land a hit on Basara himself.
rows.notes: review: refit: pronoun-free (Chlore gender unknown in glossary); 'Chlore's skill and the unit's performance' -> 'pilot skill plus performance'

rows.en: Glavil\nGavil's physical body. It needs so much Spiritia that Gavil takes\na small spirit form, merging into Gavigla to fight all-out.
rows.notes: Gavil and Glavil's combined form coined as 'Gavigla' (not in glossary). Gavigla (combined form) not in glossary. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Gepelnitchi\nLeader of the Protodeviln. To build a world of endless Spiritia,\nhe attacks humans, the "Spiritia-regenerating race" he sought.
rows.notes: Coined 'Spiritia-regenerating race' for the quoted Protodeviln term. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VT-1C Valkyrie\nA variable trainer for basic training. Basara flew it to make\nthe Galaxy Whale hear his song, but the whale shot it down.
rows.notes: Source calls it 'VT-1C Valkyrie'; mecha.json has 'VT-1C Ostrich'. Followed the source. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-17D Nightmare (Liza)\nThe unit Liza stole fleeing smugglers. Whether the bill for it\never reached the Zolan Star Patrol is anybody's guess.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-5000T-G Star Mirage\nA two-seat VF-5000 of the Zolan Star Patrol. With a Super\nBooster fitted, it played a key role in arresting the poachers.
rows.notes: Super Booster not in the packs list. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-5000G Star Mirage\nA VF-5000 of the Zolan Star Patrol. Liza complained that\nit carried nothing but non-lethal weapons.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-19P Excalibur\nThe unit Basara forced his way into to sing to the Galaxy\nWhale. Whether Ray was billed the rental is anybody's guess.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Gamlin)\nGamlin's own unit in his signature black. To let Basara's song\nbe heard, he fought the poachers without quite knowing why.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VA-C-3 Invader\nThe poachers' main variable attacker, with harpoon launcher\npods to catch Galaxy Whales and whaling mods all over it.
rows.notes: Source has no 'Kai'; mecha.json has 'VA-C-3 Invader Kai'. Followed the source. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Diving Suit\nThe suit Graham Hoilie wore to fight the Galaxy Whale.\nHarpoon in hand, he fought the white whale to the death.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Cheyenne II\nAn anti-air interceptor Destroid, a redesign of the Cheyenne.\nIt put its firepower to full use in the Macross Attack.
rows.notes: Cheyenne II and 'Macross Attack' not in glossary. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-171 Nightmare Plus\nMain variable fighter of the Frontier fleet. Weaker than its base\nVF-17, but easier for ordinary pilots to handle.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Standard)\nA VF-171 refit to fight the Vajra. Mainly flown by rank-and-file\nU.N. Forces pilots, it fought to defend the Frontier.
rows.notes: Source omits the trailing 'EX' of the nickname; mecha.json has 'VF-171EX Nightmare Plus EX'. Followed the source. 'U.N. Forces' kept literal in the Frontier era. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Alto)\nAlto's unit as Sagittarius Squadron leader. Hardly a poor\nperformer, but it couldn't keep up with Alto's skill.
rows.notes: Same nickname issue as u3260. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: RVF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Luca)\nThe unit Luca flew when Jeffrey and the others deserted.\nFor electronic warfare, it is fitted with a radome and Ghosts.
rows.notes: Same nickname issue as u3260. 'Ghosts' = the unmanned drones it carries.

rows.en: VF-25F Messiah (Alto)\nCutting-edge unit sent to military provider S.M.S., partly for\ntesting. Alto's F type is built for high-mobility combat.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-25S Messiah (Ozma)\nThe gray unit of Ozma, S.M.S. Skull Squadron's leader. It beats\nthe standard model, and is formidable with Armored Parts on.
rows.notes: Source says 'Armored Parts' rather than 'Armored Pack'; kept as written. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: VF-25G Messiah (Michel)\nA VF-25 customized for long-range combat, painted blue for\nMichel. Its sniper rifle and long-range head are trademarks.
rows.notes: Name suffix in the source uses the formal name (Mihael); used 'Michel' per the mecha.json pilot_suffix convention, matching the body text. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line
